We Effect - Cluster on Nat. Resources Mngmt - AGIR Program 2011-2014

description.narrative: Support to We Effect to identify and support national Civil Society Organisations to implement Sida program in social accountability in natural resource management. The support will as much as possible be given as core support, provided national partners fulfill some basic criteria. This is a sub-programme of the whole AGIR programme in which other sub-programmes are managed by Diakonia, Ibis and Oxfam.
